prednjeg roga, trupa i stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska. Uz prednji rog meniska formirana je
parameniscealna cista promjera 13 mm. Distenzija meniskokapsularnih sveza uz stražji rog
meniska.
Lateralni menisk je primjerene morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Blaža mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamenta, bez znakova rupture.
Primjeren nalaz stražnjeg križnog ligamenta.
Lezija I. stupnja medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Primjeren nalaz lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Entezopatske promjene tetive kvadricepsa uz moguću manju parcijalnu rupturu u medijalnom
dijelu vlakana.
Prikazane artikulacijske hrskavice urednih su intenziteta signala.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Findings:  There is a moderate knee effusion. Fluid is also noted distending a mild - moderate Baker's cyst.  There is mild degenerate tearing of the posterior body and horn of the medial meniscus. There is a horizontal tear of the body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild thinning of the weightbearing lateral compartment articular cartilage. The medial compartment articular cartilage is well preserved. Normal patellofemoral articulation.  
Conclusion: Moderate knee effusion. Medial and lateral meniscal tearing. Mild articular cartilage degeneration noted.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Rotura del menisco lateral.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Cartílagos los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
No hay derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Mínimo edema de las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial.

Findings:  Large joint effusion. No intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments. Prominent bursa deep to the MCL.  Complex degenerate tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with a full-thickness radial component of the body and a superiorly displaced component adjacent to the posterior aspect of the medial femoral condyle (see image snap shot). Intact lateral meniscus.  Normal appearance of the distal biceps femoris tendon, distal iliotibial band and pes anserine tendons. Small ganglion around the popliteus tendon.  Intact extensor mechanism. No evidence of fat pad impingement.  High-grade chondral thinning in the weightbearing portion of the medial tibiofemoral compartment. Focal high-grade chondropathy in the lateral tibial condyle with minor underlying bone stress change. High-grade chondral thinning and full-thickness chondral loss across the majority of the medial and lateral retropatellar facets. Full-thickness chondral loss is also noted in the lateral aspect of the lateral femoral trochlea groove with underlying bone stress change.  
Conclusion:  Large knee joint effusion. Complex tear of the medial meniscus as described above. MCL bursa. Tricompartmental degenerative change, prominent in the patellofemoral compartment. Ancillary findings described above.

МР находка: МР данни за медиална гонартроза. Ставният хрущял на фемура и тибията от медиалната страна е изтънен и е с неравни контури. Наличие на ставна течност на мястото на лизирания хрущял. Виждат се малки зони на субхондрален костно-мозъчен едем в медиалния кондул на фемура и тибията. Виждат се остеофити от медиалната страна на ставата. Ставните хрущяли от латералната страна на ставата и на пателата са съхранени. МР данни за ставен излив. Вижда се голяма Бекерова киста с размер 60/22мм. Визуализират се дегенеративни промени в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на този меникус е уголемен и е с повишен сигнален интензитет. В него се намират хиперинтензни линии, съответстващи на скъсване. Скъсването достига до задния край на меникускуса и до ставните повърхности на фемура и на тибията. Дегенеративни промени се откриват и в прения рог на латералния менискус, без видимо скъсване в него. Предната кръстна връзка е с изтънн напречник – находка съответсваща на частично скъсване с давност. Налричие на малка зона на отоко на костния мозък в тибията под залавното място на предната кръстна връзка. Колатералните лигаменти са със запазена цялост. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Заключение: МР данни за медиална гонартроза. Детенеративни промени в меникусите. Фрагментиран е задният рог на медиалния менискус. Частично скъсване с давност на предната кръстна връзка. Ставен излив. Бекерова киста.

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala lateralnog
kolateralnog ligamenata, prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarne
tetive i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Kompleksna ruptura korpusa i stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska, s "flap" komponentom koja se
prebacuje iznad stražnjeg roga meniska u području korijena. Korpus meniska periferno je
potisnut.
Lateralni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Reaktivni periligamentarni edem uz medijalni kolateralni ligament.
Fisure i defekti pune debljine hrskavice obje fasete patele (hondromalacija 3. stupnja prema
ICRS klasifikaciji),  uz sitne rubne osteofite - OA promjene.
Ostale prikazane artikulacijske hrskavice prožete su plitkim fisurama (hondromalacija 2. stupnja
prema ICRS klasifikaciji), uz sitne rubne osteofite FT zgloba - OA promjene.
Koštani edem medijalnog kondila tibije.
Enhondrom u lateralnom aspektu distalne metafize femura promjera 13 mm.
Opsežan izljev u koljenu, masivna poplitealna (Bakerova) cista uz koju se nalazi subfascijalna
slobodna tekućina uz stražnji rub m. gastroknemijusa. Opisano je suspektno na rupturu
Bakerove ciste, bez potpune drenaže njenog sadržaja.
Varikoziteti potkožnih vena poplitealno.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Clinical information: Left knee pain for 8 weeks, atraumatic. No improvement with physiotherapy/rehabilitation. Positive meniscus tests. Concern for LCL tear versus lateral meniscal tear. Rule out internal derangement of the knee.

Technique: Unenhanced multiplanar multiphase MRI of the left knee performed at 3.0 Tesla MRI scanner.

Findings:
There is a radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus measuring 4.5 x 3.5 mm. There is an fraying of the residual posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There are no displaced meniscal fragments. There is a moderate mucoid degeneration of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is no acute tear of the lateral meniscus.

The cruciate ligaments are intact. There is a moderate thickening with associated T2 hyperintensity of the proximal medial collateral ligament. Otherwise the collateral ligaments are intact. The extensor mechanism of the knee is unremarkable.

There are no deep cartilage defects in the medial and lateral femorotibial joint compartment. 

There is an mild chondrosis at the medial and lateral patellar facet with focal superficial cartilage irregularities at the lateral patellar facet. There are no cartilage defects, no subchondral bone marrow edema.

There is no joint effusion. There is no Baker's cyst. 

The joint articulations are well-maintained. 

There is a lobulated ganglion cyst extending along the popliteus tendon measuring 4.5 x 1.4 cm in the axial plane.

The infrapatellar fat pad is unremarkable. The visualized muscle bulk is intact.

Conclusion:
1. Radial tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. No displaced meniscal fragments. 
2. No acute ligamentous injury, especially no tear of the lateral collateral ligament.
3. Mild patellofemoral chondrosis.

Lateral compartment cartilage: Moderate to severe cartilage loss is present, most prominent at the posterior aspect. Small osteophytes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning and fissuring at the patella diffusely. Moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring is present at the trochlea diffusely, with a chondral flap at the lateral trochlear facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): There is severe mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, with evidence of chronic partial tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

2. Chondrosis in the patellofemoral and lateral tibiofemoral compartment.
3. Severe mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament with evidence of chronic partial tear.

Indication: Few day history of knee pain following skiing injury.

> Linear signal intensity in lateral meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal, maybe due to degeneration.
> The contour of PCL is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of tear.
> The contour of ACL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, R/O Anserine bursitis
> The contour of medial patellar retinaculum is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of tear.

2. Tear of PCL.
3. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus; in favor of degeneration of lateral meniscus.
4. Osteoarthritis of right knee and synovitis and mild suprapteallar bursitis.
5. Subcutanenous contusion over right knee, especially at prepatellar to infrapatellar region.
6. Anserine bursitis.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Održan intenzitet signala femoralne i tibijalne hrskavice u području lateralnih kondila.
Reducirana je širina medijalnog dijela zglobnog prostora FT zgloba uz početne degenerativne
promjene priležeće hrskavice (hondromalacija I.stupnja).
Manja zona koštanog edema interokondilarne eminencije, uz hvatište prednjeg križnog ligamenta.
Ostale koštane strukture primjerenih intenziteta signala.
Umjerena količina izljeva u zglobni prostor.
Diskontinuitet prednjeg križneg ligamenta u smislu kompletne rupture u srednjoj trećini.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Prikaže se kompleksna, predominantno longitudinalna ruptura medijalnog meniska koja se prati od
prednjeg do stražnjeg roga, bez jasno formiranog "flap"-a. Edem piležeće zglobne čahure.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova degeneracije ili rupture.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je valovito konturiran uz intrasupstancijski povišen intezitet signala
u smislu parcijalne rupture.
Povišen je intezitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa kao i blaže patelarnog ligamenta u smislu
entezopatskih promjena.
Bez znakova poplitealne ciste.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba. Uredan intenzitet signala
patelarne i trohlearne hrskavice.
